Brace `{r} 1+1` and again `{r} 2+2`.

Null: brace [`{r} NULL`].

Invisible `{r} invisible(3)` and assignment `{r} (x <- 4)`.

Numbers: `{r} pi`, `{r} 0.1 + 0.2`, `{r} 42`, `{r} 1/3`.

Specials: brace `{r} "**bold** a_b"`.

Asis: brace `{r} knitr::asis_output("**asis**")`.

Vector: `{r} c(1, 2, 3)` and `{r} c("a", "b")`.

- list item with `{r} 2+2` and `{r} "x_y"`
